req.title: List returns empty array when db empty
req.statement: The system shall return an empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist.
triggers: list returns empty array when db empty

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-033 requires GET /tasks/ to return an empty JSON array when no tasks exist. The pre-loaded fixture has 20 rows, so tests that need an empty DB must override the dependency. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive — empty DB returns [] with status 200; (2) negative — invalid query param (skip=-1) returns 422, not 2xx; (3) boundary — DB with exactly 1 task returns a 1-element array, then after deletion returns [], confirming the boundary between non-empty and empty. Each test uses FastAPI's dependency_overrides to inject a fresh in-memory SQLite session so tests are isolated and deterministic.

preconditions: No tasks exist in the database

expected: Response body is exactly an empty JSON array []

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array():
    engine_mem = create_engine(
        "sqlite:///:memory:",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
    )
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)

    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert body == []
        assert isinstance(body, list)
        assert len(body) == 0
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array()

Assert GET /tasks/ returns exactly empty array []

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_list_tasks_boundary_one_then_zero_tasks():
    engine_mem = create_engine(
        "sqlite:///:memory:",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
    )
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)

    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        post_r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "completed": False})
        assert post_r.status_code == 201
        task_id = post_r.json()["id"]
        r1 = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r1.status_code == 200
        body1 = r1.json()
        assert isinstance(body1, list)
        assert len(body1) == 1
        assert body1[0]["title"] == "Boundary Task"
        del_r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
        assert del_r.status_code == 204
        r2 = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r2.status_code == 200
        body2 = r2.json()
        assert body2 == []
        assert len(body2) == 0
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_list_tasks_boundary_one_then_zero_tasks()
